data.notes: August 2026 is anchored by SantAnna’s confirmed electronic music program, Scorpios/Cavo Paradiso highlights, and the multi-venue XLSIOR festival late in the month.

events.title: XLSIOR Festival Mykonos 2026
events.summary: XLSIOR’s official site confirms the 2026 Mykonos edition for August 20–25. The festival is a multi-day, multi-venue LGBTQ+ dance event on the island.

events.title: Black Coffee at SantAnna
events.summary: SantAnna confirms Black Coffee for Monday, August 10 as part of his six-Monday summer residency. The event is listed from 18:00 to 00:00 at Paraga Beach.

events.title: Marco Carola & Dennis Cruz
events.summary: SantAnna confirms Marco Carola and Dennis Cruz for a Wednesday, August 5 session. The event is listed for 18:00–00:00 at Paraga Beach.

events.title: Sonny Fodera & Roger Sanchez at SantAnna
events.summary: Sonny Fodera and Roger Sanchez headline SantAnna on Friday, August 14. Resident Advisor lists the party from 18:00 to 00:00 and categorizes the music as house.

events.title: SantAnna presents Vintage Culture
events.summary: Vintage Culture plays SantAnna Mykonos on Saturday, August 15. The confirmed Resident Advisor listing places the event at SantAnna from 18:00 to 00:00.

events.title: Black Coffee — 2026 Residency at SantAnna
events.summary: SantAnna’s Monday Black Coffee residency continues through August, with confirmed August dates on 3, 10, and 17 August; a peak-season Afro-house anchor for the island.

events.title: SantAnna presents Mochakk
events.summary: Mochakk headlines SantAnna Mykonos on Saturday, August 1, with a house-focused poolside set. Resident Advisor lists the event from 18:00 to 00:00 at SantAnna in Paraga Beach.

events.title: Francis Mercier presents Solèy at SantAnna
events.summary: Francis Mercier brings his Solèy residency to SantAnna on Saturday, August 8, with Joezi also listed on the lineup. The concept is framed around house and Afro-house sounds with live-instrument elements.

events.title: Adam Port, Little D at Scorpios
events.summary: A peak Sunday Scorpios terrace booking with Keinemusik co-founder Adam Port alongside Little D, centered on the global Afro/electronic house sound currently defining high-season Mykonos.

events.title: Shimza, Jean Claude Ades, STOFFELA at Scorpios
events.summary: A major Afro-house terrace ritual at Scorpios with South African force Shimza, resident selector Jean Claude Ades, and rising talent STOFFELA.

events.title: Marlon Hoffstadt at SantAnna
events.summary: Marlon Hoffstadt plays SantAnna Mykonos on Friday, August 7. Resident Advisor lists the event as an 18:00–00:00 session with techno and trance-leaning programming.

events.title: SantAnna presents Mahmut Orhan & Rivo
events.summary: Mahmut Orhan and Rivo are confirmed for SantAnna Mykonos on Saturday, August 22. Resident Advisor lists the event as an 18:00–00:00 house and Afro-house session.

events.title: David Morales at Cavo Paradiso
events.summary: David Morales is listed at Cavo Paradiso on Friday, August 21. Resident Advisor confirms the event at the Paradise Beach club from 23:00 to 06:00.

events.title: Scorpios Label Night with Samm B2B Lannka feat. Zhoca, Little D B2B DSF
events.summary: A Scorpios Music label showcase uniting Samm, Lannka, Zhoca, Little D, and DSF for the venue’s in-house organic/electronic scene rather than a one-off headliner play.

events.title: Dawn Patrol: Maz B2B Antdot at Alemagou
events.summary: Alemagou’s Dawn Patrol date pairs Maz and Antdot for a beachside Afro-house, Afro-tech, melodic-house, and organic-house session.

events.title: RY X at Scorpios Beach Club
events.summary: Songkick lists RY X at Scorpios Beach Club in Mykonos on Friday, August 7. The event is confirmed at the Paraga venue with RY X as headliner.

events.title: ANOTR, Tess at Scorpios
events.summary: ANOTR return to Scorpios with Tess for a house-forward terrace night described by the venue as hypnotic, instinctive, and movement-led.

events.title: ANOTR, Bella Backe at Scorpios
events.summary: A Sunday terrace session at Scorpios led by ANOTR’s groove-led house sound with Bella Backe adding disco, soul, funk, and house energy.

events.title: Kim Turnbull at Buddha-Bar Beach, Santa Marina
events.venueName: Buddha-Bar Beach at Santa Marina Mykonos
events.summary: London DJ Kim Turnbull brings a diaspora-leaning luxury-club set blending hip-hop, Afrobeats, amapiano, and electronic music at Buddha-Bar Beach.

events.title: Fiona Jane at Buddha-Bar Beach, Santa Marina
events.venueName: Buddha-Bar Beach at Santa Marina Mykonos
events.summary: Danish DJ/producer Fiona Jane closes Santa Marina’s Buddha-Bar Beach season with a full-moon set spanning house, indie dance, nu-disco, and melodic techno.
